tracks: Discard 1 Twist to place 2, or place 1 free
rules: Shuffle 9 books; start with 3 in a triangle: two side by side, one centered below. Stack the rest face down. Books use a hexagonal grid; each has 2 pages. A touching page edge or internal fold costs 1 move. Each player takes a protagonist, 10 Inklings and 12 memories (3 per row). Start at 0 points, with 4 supply Inklings, 3 reserved for Act II, 3 for Act III; cover every upgrade with a memory. Shuffle decks; deal 2 Twists and 1 face-up Subplot each. No starting characters. Place protagonists on any pages. From the base pool of 15 conflict tokens (5 per Act), randomly select 1 per player for EACH Act; set the rest aside. Display Act I's tokens. Choose a first player; turns go clockwise.

With no supply Inklings at the start, shoot the moon (below). Otherwise move your protagonist at least 1 page, up to your movement limit, ending on a different page from its starting page. Then choose ONE action: place Inklings on its page using Resolve; replace one of your Inklings there with a memory; OR place 1 supply Inkling on a character's empty activation square and use its action. Characters move only through abilities and carry nothing. Twists are played ONLY in conflict. Resolve immediate conflicts before continuing any remaining placements. Finish effects, then discard to your hand limit and end your turn.

Use empty numbered spaces on your active page; if full, use shared overflow. Every numbered space EXCEPT the first and last across a book shows a Twist: placing an Inkling there draws 1 Twist, including bonus placements. Also gain any memory rewards there. Moving an Inkling grants no placement rewards. Erase returns it to its owner's supply; suspend sends it to their NEXT Act reserve (out of play in Act III). Foreshadow moves Inklings from next reserve to supply; gain 1 point each if unavailable. Gain a character by drawing the top card onto your protagonist's page unless stated otherwise; empty deck gives 2 points. Figures fill no spaces, except Agamemnon's trigger exception. Characters move between adjacent pages unless stated otherwise.

Suspend your Inkling from a numbered space without a memory; replace it with the leftmost covered memory from any row, improving that row. The space becomes empty. Memories add no power, never fill spaces and grant no Twist check. An Inkling may later occupy a memory space; it counts normally. Its owner and the memory owner each gain that memory's benefit (once if the same player), in that order. Curiosity places its bonus Inkling in this book's overflow. Returning a memory lowers its row; an Inkling on it stays. Extra upgrades still suspend Inklings; if impossible, gain 2 points.

Track events only while your Subplot is face up; retain progress if pieces disappear. When full, choose a character OR its alternative reward. Resolve it, discard the Subplot and draw a new one. No retroactive progress. Reshuffle Twist/Subplot discards as needed. Played conflict Twists stay aside until scoring.

Finish placement rewards, then immediately fight when the last numbered space gains an Inkling, interrupting further placements. Agamemnon triggers with 1 space still empty; that empty space grants no check. All players with Inklings or figures here participate; lock them in. Reveal the Horse; resolve book/character start effects. Check numbered spaces ONCE, left to right. At each, its CURRENT Inkling owner may play 1 Twist or pass. Skip empty or memory-only spaces; overflow grants no checks. Each owned space is a separate opportunity. Agamemnon/Strategists allow 1 extra Twist at ONE owned check per conflict, not cumulatively. Later spaces use their current occupants; earlier spaces never repeat. Finish even if erasures or upgrades empty spaces. Other full books wait until this conflict finishes.

After checks, total Inklings (1 each), character power, protagonist Valor and effects. Most power wins; ties favor the earliest participant clockwise from the active player. Discard all played Twists. Resolve win/loss and book after-effects, then erase all Inklings here. Memories and figures stay. EVERY conflict takes 1 available current-Act token. Only an uncovered +3 space scores 3 times the NEW token's multiplier (x1/x2/x3); then cover it. A covered book gives NO printed book points. Gain every token's face-up reward in your chosen order: strong bonus or weak 1/2/3 points, never multiplied; flip them weak. The winner then draws and publishes a book touching at least 2 others and places 1 supply Inkling in a touching old book's overflow. No books left: skip publication and its bonus.

The last available token ends the Act: finish that conflict, rewards and publication, then end the turn. No conflict resolves without an available token. With no supply at turn START, gain each unused token's strong bonus without book points, multipliers or publication; then end the Act. After Act III, highest points wins; ties share victory. Otherwise flip old tokens strong, uncover each +3 space, return character-card Inklings to supply, release the next reserve, prepare the Horse and display the next Act's selected tokens. Book Inklings stay. Next player starts. Any waiting full book resolves before normal movement.
